howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Match your menu to your brand in three simple steps.

steps.title: Open Design Settings
steps.description: Navigate to the Design page in your dashboard. The accent color picker is front and center — you'll see all available options immediately.

steps.title: Pick Your Brand Color
steps.description: Choose from 12 curated color presets designed for readability and accessibility, or enter your exact hex code for a perfect brand match.

steps.title: Instant Preview
steps.description: Your accent color applies to buttons, links, and highlights across the entire menu. It works in both light and dark themes, and changes appear instantly on your live menu.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about menu customization.

items.question: Can I use my exact brand color?
items.answer: Yes. Enter any hex color code, or choose from 12 carefully selected presets. Your accent color applies across all pages of your menu.

items.question: Can I change colors after publishing?
items.answer: Absolutely. Change your accent color anytime from the dashboard. Updates appear instantly on your live menu — no republishing needed.

items.question: Will my QR code match the brand colors too?
items.answer: Your QR code is generated separately and can be customized independently. The accent color applies to your digital menu pages, navigation, and interactive elements.

items.question: Does the accent color work with dark mode?
items.answer: Yes. Your chosen accent color is applied in both light and dark themes. The system automatically adjusts brightness and contrast to ensure readability in either mode.

items.question: Is custom color available on the free plan?
items.answer: Yes. The accent color feature is available on every plan, including free. All restaurants can match their menu to their brand at no cost.

items.question: Which elements use the accent color?
items.answer: The accent color is applied to buttons, links, active states, highlights, and navigation elements across your entire menu — homepage, menu page, contacts, and reservation page.
